name: Distribute siblings
author: Lienzo UI
description: Spacing tools for groups of sibling elements: spread them evenly or stack them with a fixed gap, moving their children along.

commands.name: Spread evenly (horizontal)
commands.description: Keeps the first and last sibling and makes every horizontal gap equal.

commands.name: Spread evenly (vertical)
commands.description: Keeps the first and last sibling and makes every vertical gap equal.

commands.name: Stack in a row (16 px gap)
commands.description: Places siblings left to right with a 16 px gap.

commands.name: Stack in a column (16 px gap)
commands.description: Places siblings top to bottom with a 16 px gap.
